summary: /tag scrolled sideways in Firefox on phones: the Letter preview stayed 680 px, because its scale used calc(length / length) (unsupported in Firefox) and nothing set the --sheet-k fallback.
fix: The scale is zoom: min(1, tan(atan2(100cqi, --letter-w))), a number every current engine computes; SheetFit sets --sheet-k from the column where even that isn't supported.
